target_customer: Specialty healthcare providers and pharmacies handling referrals, prior authorizations and appeals
problem: Patient intake and prior authorization require manual document handling that delays treatment. Trellis agents extract referral data, draft medical necessity letters and submit authorizations.
business_model: B2B SaaS and agent platform sold to healthcare providers via demos, pricing not disclosed

founders.name: Mac Klinkachorn
founders.background_notes: YC page does not list education

founders.name: Jacky Lin
founders.background_notes: Taught AI to Stanford graduate students per YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Unstructured document extraction plus payer workflow automation needed reliable LLM pipelines and healthcare integrations, hard but within reach of a small ML team in 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow integrations with provider systems and payer-specific learned rules raise switching costs, but the core extraction tech was available to others.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents and several startups pursued prior authorization automation; no source shows an acquisition of Trellis as of late 2026.

market_need_then: Prior authorization is a widely criticized administrative burden, and 2023 to 2024 LLM advances made document automation newly feasible.

branding.domain_note: Operates at runtrellis.com, suggesting the plain trellis.com was unavailable; not confirmed by a source

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with many companies, including a legal analytics firm with a product also called Trellis AI, which crowds search. No brand press found.

pivots.to: AI agents for healthcare prior authorization and intake
pivots.why: Not stated in sources; two YC launch posts show both framings

outcome_analysis: Trellis is active, with team size growing from around 25 to 55 per YC listings, many open roles, and a focused healthcare agent suite. It focused from general data structuring onto prior authorization. Investors are named (YC, General Catalyst, Telesoft) but no round sizes or dates are public, so the funding outcome is unknown.
notes: Investors per the YC page: YC, General Catalyst, Telesoft Partners, Google and Salesforce executives, with no amounts or dates. StartupHub lists 500K total, a single aggregator, unverified. Competitor sources found were undated 2025 to 2026 aggregators, so competition at founding is left empty. Company page fetch for YC page lacked education.
